answer: Fake swarms stay cheap if work can be sharded. Bind each new identity to a delay cipher: a 36-hour hash ladder whose start nonce is published in a public ridge book and whose final digest unlocks a 240-unit refundable bond. Routers accept a peer only when live ladder height matches that book. Identities that wander onto a reused nonce fail a three-way height audit (book, mempool receipts, peer samples) and forfeit the bond. Cost is wall-clock plus locked capital; verification is one height compare. If a cartel precomputes ladders, rotate the ridge salt each epoch and slash stale heights.
